description: Who sponsors a given podcast. Returns every brand whose ad read was detected in that show's transcribed episodes, with how many reads, whether they were host-read or network-inserted, and when they were first and last heard. Accepts a show title, a trackpodcasts.com slug or a URL. If the title is ambiguous it returns candidate shows to choose from instead of guessing. Detected ad reads only — brands that were merely mentioned are not included.

show.description: Podcast title, slug or trackpodcasts.com URL, e.g. "The Glenn Beck Program".

name: get_show_sponsors
title: Sponsors of a podcast
